status_as_of_cutoff: The city records a concept review, Final AUAR and Mitigation Plan adoption on 2026-01-26, and applications received on 2026-07-06 that remain under completeness review. Public materials and local/trade reporting associate Microsoft/Frattalone with the concept, but the city has not published a final site-plan approval, building permit, construction start, inspection, CO, utility service, energization, commissioning, or initial-service record.

actions.government_body: City of Monticello Planning Commission and City Council
actions.result_status: The city held a joint workshop to review a potential approximately 3 million-square-foot technology campus. Concept review is expressly not a formal zoning or land-use application.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: Monticello Industrial AUAR / technology campus concept
actions.access_caveat: Workshop and concept review do not establish approval, permit, or construction.

actions.action_type: AUAR scoping acceptance / order for full study
actions.result_status: The city says Council accepted the AUAR Scoping Document and ordered the full AUAR study for the proposed 550-acre technology campus.
actions.access_caveat: Environmental-review authorization is not a data-center land-use approval or building permit.

actions.result_status: The City Council adopted the Final AUAR and Mitigation Plan for Monticello Industrial. The city page states that AUAR adoption does not itself approve a data center.
actions.access_caveat: The cited page does not expose a roll-call tally; AUAR adoption is not final site-plan approval.

actions.result_status: The city posted DCPUD/CUP, rezone, preliminary-plat, final-plat, utility, water, sanitary, stormwater, traffic, noise, and mitigation materials received July 6. The applications were still being reviewed for completeness and no public-hearing date had been set.
actions.access_caveat: Application receipt is not approval, permit issuance, construction authorization, or evidence that the public materials are complete.
actions.evidence_note: Official current status; utility and environmental submissions are preserved without treating them as approvals.
